terms.gloss: a prosecutor, an accuser; feminine accūsātrīx
terms.comment: The accuser in a criminal case; in a private suit the plaintiff is petītor (Lewis & Short).

phrases.source: Traupman 196; cf. Cic. Fam. 1.9.15 (Lewis & Short s.v. persequor)

sources: Lewis & Short: accusator · Lewis & Short: persequor
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 190, 196, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
